description: This file defines a Spring MVC controller class 'DigitalProductController' responsible for managing digital products in an admin interface. It includes handlers for viewing, saving, and removing digital product files, utilizing services for product and digital content management.

classes.name: DigitalProductController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for managing digital product files in the admin interface, including viewing, saving, and deleting files associated with products.

methods.name: getDigitalProduct
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve and display the digital product details by product ID.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save uploaded digital files for a specific product; processes file uploads and associates them with the product.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Handles POST requests to remove a digital product file based on file ID, returning JSON response indicating success or failure.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Private helper method to set up menu context in the model for view rendering.
